Created by bg3.exe+0x428F5F0 (slot 27 of the table bg3.exe+0x5B9A668); read by bg3.exe+0x1C4D080 for ecl::PickingHelper::Update (bg3.exe+0x1C44B80, Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0xF5F570), which copies it to PickingHelper +0x1C4/+0x1C8 and raises the flag +0x1CC; ecl::PickingHelper::NudgeSelection (EoCClient.dll+0xF5ABA0) reads those as floats. Never seen alive. Registry total 8 (client row; no server size). No savegame model, not replicated.
